WITH category_ratios AS (
  SELECT e.type AS event_type,
         CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0) AS ratio
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN event AS e
    ON CAST(e.event_id AS BLOB) = CAST(b.link_to_event AS BLOB)
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT event_type, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
  FROM category_ratios
  GROUP BY event_type
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
  FROM type_averages
)
SELECT t.event_type,
       t.average_ratio,
       t.average_ratio - o.average_ratio
FROM type_averages AS t
JOIN overall_average AS o
  ON o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL
